topic: What if Corazon never gave Law the Ope Ope Fruit, and how Marineford, Dressrosa and Wano change
title: What If Corazon Never Gave Law The Ope Ope Fruit?
description:
What if Donquixote Rosinante, Corazon, never gave a thirteen-year-old Trafalgar Law the Ope Ope no Mi? Follow the fallout from Flevance to Marineford, Dressrosa and Wano, and the twist about who the fruit's price really belonged to.

This is a theory-driven What If built on canon: Amber Lead Syndrome, Doflamingo's plan for the Perennial Youth Operation, Law's rescue of Luffy, and the Road Poneglyph etchings Blackbeard wants. Which domino would you save first?
comment: Was Corazon's gift worth more than anything Luffy did at Dressrosa, or did Luffy's strength carry the story on its own? Pick one.

lines.text: A thirteen-year-old boy is locked inside a treasure chest, and the man who put him there can't make a sound.

lines.text: That man is Corazon. The boy is Trafalgar Law. And what Corazon did right before that lid closed holds up half of One Piece.

lines.text: Because that fruit didn't just save a child. It sits underneath the whole second half of Luffy's story.

lines.text: Start with who Law is when this story begins. He's thirteen, and he's the last person left from Flevance.

shot.fallback: the white snowy city of Flevance under a gray sky, anime style

lines.text: Flevance was called the White City, famous for the amber lead its people mined and sold to the whole North Blue.

shot.fallback: the white snowy city of Flevance under a gray sky, anime style

lines.text: That same amber lead gave the town Amber Lead Syndrome, a sickness that turns the skin white and doesn't let go.

lines.text: Law's parents and his little sister are gone. The outside world treats Flevance like a disease to be erased.

shot.fallback: the white snowy city of Flevance under a gray sky, anime style

lines.text: He walks out of the ashes alone, and somehow he ends up with the Donquixote Pirates.

shot.fallback: the white snowy city of Flevance under a gray sky, anime style

lines.text: His plan back then, as I read it, isn't to live. It's to take the world down with him.

shot.fallback: the white snowy city of Flevance under a gray sky, anime style

lines.text: Then Corazon enters, a clumsy man in a feathered coat who tosses Law out of a window on day one.

shot.fallback: the white snowy city of Flevance under a gray sky, anime style

lines.text: But Corazon is a Marine spy sent by Sengoku, and his real job is to watch his own brother.

lines.text: Yes, Doflamingo's younger brother. That detail matters in a minute, so keep it in your pocket.

shot.fallback: the white snowy city of Flevance under a gray sky, anime style

lines.text: Corazon spends years in that crew with a painted smile and a feathered coat, passing information to the Marines.

shot.fallback: the white snowy city of Flevance under a gray sky, anime style

lines.text: Sengoku sends him, and I doubt Sengoku expected the spy to fall for the boy he was told to ignore.

shot.fallback: the white snowy city of Flevance under a gray sky, anime style

lines.text: He is clumsy on purpose, I think. A man nobody fears is a man nobody checks.

shot.fallback: the white snowy city of Flevance under a gray sky, anime style

shot.fallback: the white snowy city of Flevance under a gray sky, anime style

lines.text: That's the scene that tells you everything. A spy with a mission, using the mission's time to look for a cure.

lines.text: He lives, and Doflamingo owns the reason he lives. Think about what that does to a thirteen-year-old.

shot.fallback: a young boy bound by a golden string held by a laughing pirate in pink feathers

lines.text: In canon, Law carries a debt to a man who asked for nothing back. Here, the debt belongs to Doflamingo.

shot.fallback: a young boy bound by a golden string held by a laughing pirate in pink feathers

lines.text: And a debt like that doesn't end in a feathered coat. It ends in an operating room.

lines.text: Dressrosa, in canon, is the kingdom Doflamingo rules as a Warlord, and the alliance's first big move is breaking it open.

shot.fallback: the Dressrosa royal palace under a red sky with a giant pink bird cage, anime style
